description: This file defines the core classes and logic for handling the connection with a remote Playwright server, including managing objects, messaging, and event handling. It implements the 'Connection' class responsible for sending and receiving messages, object lifecycle, and plugin interactions.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents the root object in the connection, initializes the Playwright instance.

classes.name: DummyChannelOwner
classes.description: A placeholder class extending ChannelOwner, possibly for unused or mock purposes.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Manages communication with the remote server, object lifecycle, message dispatching, and event handling.

methods.name: async initialize(): Promise<Playwright> { initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Playwright instance via the root object.

methods.name: sendMessageToServer
methods.description: Sends a message to the remote server, manages callback promises, and handles logging.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from the server, resolving or rejecting callbacks, or emitting events.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection and rejects all pending callbacks.

methods.name: getObjectWithKnownName
methods.description: Retrieves a stored object by its GUID.

methods.name: useRawBuffers
methods.description: Enables the use of raw buffers for data transfer.

methods.name: rawBuffers
methods.description: Checks if raw buffers are enabled.

methods.name: localUtils
methods.description: Returns local utilities object if available.

methods.name: isRemote
methods.description: Returns whether the connection is marked as remote.
